purpose: The loading state of a generative AI response (Cloudscape generative AI loading states and loading bar, AI Elements Loader): visible loading text — `Generating a response`, `Loading list of workloads` — paired with three pulsing dots (`inline`, for text) or an indeterminate bar (`bar`, where a table, list or code block is about to appear). It waits `delay` milliseconds before showing anything, so a response that arrives within a second never flickers a loading state.
useWhen: Processing: the model has the prompt but has produced nothing yet (`ChatMessage` renders it for `state="pending"`).
Generation of mixed content: a bar where a table or code block will appear while text streams.
avoidWhen: Loading a page or table of product data → `skeleton`, `spinner`, `progress`.
related: progress` — the indeterminate bar it draws.
bestPractices: Text says `[Generating|Loading] <what>` without end punctuation: `Generating a response`, `Loading list of workloads`.
Keep the default 1 s delay; set `delay` to 0 only when the owner already delayed.
Use the bar only for non-text content; stream text instead of loading it.
